data.title: South Korea test-fires its first homegrown hypersonic weapon: presidency
data.description: SEOUL - South Korea test-fired its first homegrown hypersonic weapon on Thursday, the presidential office said, days after Pyongyang announced the AI-assisted launch of an intermediate-range hypersonic missile.

data.title: Ex-PTTEP executive in Rolls-Royce bribery case found in Indonesia
data.description: A former senior executive of PTT Exploration and Production Plc (PTTEP) wanted under an Interpol Red Notice in connection with a high-profile bribery case was arrested in Indonesia and is being returned to Thailand, according to the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC)

data.title: Health Economy Tipped as Thailand’s Next Major Growth Engine Amid Rising Global Wellness Demand
data.description: Experts say longevity tech and medical tourism can power growth, but slow regulatory approvals, imported inputs and a brain drain threaten it

data.title: Authorities search Jewish buildings in Bangkok
data.description: Authorities searched three buildings associated with Israelis in Bangkok on Thursday as part of an investigation into foreigners’ business activities in Thailand.

data.title: Ethiopia drones hit Eritrean troops in Tigray
data.description: ADDIS ABABA - Ethiopian drone strikes targeted Eritrean forces who had reached a northern Tigrayan city, a conflict monitor and witnesses said on Thursday, amid fears of a wider regional war.

data.title: Canada's Anne Carson wins Nobel literature prize
data.description: STOCKHOLM - The Nobel Prize in Literature was awarded on Thursday to Canadian poet Anne Carson, an essayist and classicist who brings a modern twist to mysticism and antiquity in her writings about love, desire and despair.

data.title: Anne Carson: modern takes on Greek classics
data.description: OTTAWA - Canadian-born poet, essayist and translator Anne Carson, who was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature on Thursday, has brought a modern twist to mysticism and antiquity in her unclassifiable writings about love, desire and despair.

data.title: Marcos says Philippines ‘resigned’ to managing South China Sea dispute
data.description: SINGAPORE — The Philippines is “resigned” to managing its long-standing dispute with Beijing in the South China Sea and avoiding dangerous escalations, President Ferdinand Marcos Jnr said on Thursday.

data.title: Russian strike on buses kills 30 in frontline Ukrainian city
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - Ukraine on Thursday accused Russia of deliberately targeting civilians after 30 people were killed when two buses were blown up in the frontline city of Kramatorsk, in one of the deadliest single attacks for weeks.

data.title: Beware Boiúna: Amazonian survival horror takes on a legendary serpent
data.description: In the untamed Amazon, the anaconda may not be the only giant reptile lurking deep in the forest.

data.title: Thailand begins extradition process against Chinese journalist
data.description: Thai authorities began extradition proceedings on Thursday against a Chinese investigative reporter wanted by Beijing and detained for months in Thailand, his lawyer and an official told AFP.

data.title: Saudi capital on high alert after blasts
data.description: RIYADH - Diplomats stationed in the Saudi capital were sheltering in place and international schools took safety measures on Thursday, diplomats and residents told AFP, after explosions echoed across the city.

data.title: ‘Ambitious’ goals set out in text of climate talks
data.description: NADI, Fiji - Organisers of an upcoming UN climate summit in Turkey said Thursday they would prepare a summary text for countries to adopt, as they lead a push for “ambitious” action on keeping the goal of global temperature rise of 1.5 C within reach.

data.title: Chris Hemsworth takes a Muay Thai break in Thailand
data.description: Hollywood star Chris Hemsworth, best known as Thor in the Marvel Cinematic Universe, has been taking time to practise Muay Thai while in Bangkok to film “Extraction 3”.

data.title: Queen makes first solo flight in Gripen fighter jet
data.description: Her Majesty the Queen made her first solo flight in a Gripen fighter jet in Surat Thani on Thursday.

data.title: B. Braun Thailand named Best Company to Work for in Asia for seventh year
data.description: B. Braun (Thailand) Ltd, one of the world's leading medical technology companies, has been recognised as HR Asia's "Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2026" for the seventh consecutive year. Demonstrating its continued focus on workplace culture, the company also received two special honours: the "HR Asia Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Award" for the fourth consecutive year, and the "HR Asia Sustainable Workplace Award" for the second consecutive year.

data.title: Worker killed in crane accident at Bangkok construction site
data.description: A construction worker was killed after becoming entangled in a crane cable on the roof of a hospital construction site in the Chaeng Watthana area of Bangkok on Thursday morning.

data.title: Novo launches holistic care treatment for adults living with type 2 diabetes
data.description: Novo launches a higher dose Semaglutide treatment option in Thailand for adults with type 2 diabetes.

data.title: UK consulate in Jerusalem ceases operations
data.description: JERUSALEM - The British consulate in Jerusalem ended its functions on Thursday but seven diplomats would be allowed to remain in a limited capacity, with the UK saying it would continue to offer “vital services”.

data.title: US opens direct talks with Myanmar
data.description: WASHINGTON - The Trump administration has begun direct talks with Myanmar’s military-installed government, according to US officials and others familiar with the outreach, in ​a sharp reversal of Washington’s efforts to isolate the country’s generals after the 2021 coup.
